correctness.rationale: PASS: Nonfixed ordered-letter pairs fall into 2r(r+f) two-element coordinatewise-involution orbits, bounding the number of distinct allowable cyclic digrams. The quotient edge graph has two P_i→P_j edges of bit-flip labels 0/1 for every ordered pair, and one P_i↔F_a in each direction; it is balanced/strongly connected. A fixed symbol resets lift parity and makes an Eulerian cycle of all orbits lift to a word. If f=0, the xor of edge labels around a lifted word must vanish, but xor of all 2r² orbit edges is r² mod2, so odd r forces at least one omitted orbit; deleting one label-one self-loop preserves balance and connectivity and achieves 2r²−1. For even r all orbits lift. Direct independent constructions passed 64 small (f,r) cases, not used as an infinite argument.
